Definition: Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite
BiblicalUsage: Jonadab or Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"; 1) a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab; 2) a nephew of David
